# Cognis Group | AI Consulting, Strategy & Agent Engineering

Last updated: 2026-08-25

> Cognis Group helps organisations decide where AI can help, train their people and build safe tools for everyday work. Lagos-headquartered, globally engaged.

## About

Cognis Group is a Lagos-headquartered AI consulting and engineering firm. We help organisations across Africa and beyond plan, build and use AI with confidence. Every engagement leaves the client team more capable and able to manage what we deliver.

**Quod Tango Muto: What we touch, we change.**

## Core capabilities

Three practice areas (see https://cognis.group/our-services/):

1. **AI Strategy & Advisory** — Choose the right AI opportunities and get a clear plan with priorities, owners, costs, safeguards and measures of success. (https://cognis.group/our-services/ai-strategy-advisory/)
2. **AI Training & Workforce Development** — Practical, role-based training that helps leaders and teams work better, check AI output and use approved tools safely. (https://cognis.group/our-services/ai-training-workforce-development/)
3. **AI Agent & Automation Engineering** — AI tools that handle agreed steps in business processes, with clear limits, human approval and monitoring. (https://cognis.group/our-services/ai-agent-automation-engineering/)

Clear AI rules, responsibilities, checks and records are built into every engagement. Where relevant, the work aligns with NDPA 2023, CBN guidance, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF and the EU AI Act.

## Products

Beyond advisory, Cognis Group builds and operates its own software. Four products (see https://cognis.group/products/):

1. **Cognis AI** (https://ai.cognis.group) — Specialised AI support for customer service, voice calls, company knowledge, operations or trade. Each tool starts with people checking its work and only takes on more responsibility after it proves reliable. Tagline: "Hire AI to do the work." Status: Live.
2. **MarketSage** (https://www.marketsage.africa) — A marketing and sales tool that researches prospects, helps plan campaigns and shows which activity creates sales opportunities. Tagline: "Marketing that thinks, acts, and converts." Status: Live.
3. **Migratio** (https://migratio.cognis.group) — A tool that helps banks, ministries and regulated organisations move data safely, check it before the change and keep a record of every step. Status: Live.
4. **SPOG** (https://spog.cognis.group) — One dashboard for IT, networks, facilities, vehicles and security, with every number linked to its source. Status: Live.

## Where African context meets AI engineering

Our strength is deep African market knowledge combined with global AI engineering experience. We understand local data, rules, infrastructure and working realities, and senior people remain close to the work.

We work remotely, on-site, and through hybrid engagement models.

## Our operating principles

- **We turn plans into working tools.** Every engagement leaves the organisation more capable.
- **AI does not take the place of people. It helps them work better and more efficiently.**
- **Lagos-headquartered. Globally engaged. What we touch, we change.**

## 2026 expert field notes

### Kola Olatunde — AI security and governance

- **Securing AI Agents in Production: A 2026 Threat Model** — Bounded identity, least-privilege tools, hostile-context containment, approval gates, investigation-grade traces, and tested recovery. https://cognis.group/blog/securing-ai-agents-in-production/
- **Enterprise RAG Security: Prompt Injection, Data Exfiltration, and Access Control** — Retrieval-time authorisation, secure ingestion, provenance, context minimisation, trace protection, and adversarial testing. https://cognis.group/blog/enterprise-rag-security-prompt-injection-data-exfiltration/
- **AI Governance in Africa in 2026: From Policy to Operating Controls** — A cross-jurisdiction control baseline built around inventory, risk tiers, evidence gates, evaluation, accountability, monitoring, and retirement. https://cognis.group/blog/ai-governance-africa-2026/

Author profile: https://cognis.group/teams/kola-olatunde/

### Tosin Salami — AI products and agents

- **From Copilot to Coworker: How to Productize AI Agents** — Job contracts, workflow selection, staged autonomy, user trust, MVP measurement, and narrow launch criteria. https://cognis.group/blog/from-copilot-to-coworker-productizing-ai-agents/
- **The AI Agent Product Operating System: Evals, Telemetry, Pricing, and Lifecycle** — Regression datasets, production metrics, failure review, versioning, unit economics, and evidence-based autonomy. https://cognis.group/blog/ai-agent-product-operating-system/

Author profile: https://cognis.group/teams/tosin-salami/

## Frequently asked

**What does Cognis Group actually do?** We help organisations decide where AI will be useful, prepare their people and build the tools they need. Our three main services are AI Strategy & Advisory, AI Training & Workforce Development, and AI Agent & Automation Engineering. We also build and operate Cognis AI, MarketSage, Migratio and SPOG.

**Where is Cognis Group based?** Registered in Lagos with Nigeria's Corporate Affairs Commission, with offices in Cheyenne (USA), Ontario (Canada), and Lagos (Nigeria). Cognis serves organisations across Africa, Europe, and North America.

**What industries do you serve?** We work across all sectors, including large organisations, public institutions, banks, small and medium-sized businesses, and international organisations operating in or expanding into Africa.

**How do you approach safe and responsible AI?** We set clear rules, responsibilities, checks and records before a system goes live. Where relevant, we align the work with NDPA and CBN guidance, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF and the EU AI Act.

**How does a Lagos-based firm work with clients elsewhere?** We combine African market knowledge with global AI engineering experience and work remotely, on-site or through a mix of both.

**What makes Cognis practical?** Senior people stay close to the work. We agree clear goals, build what is needed, test it in real working conditions and prepare the client team to manage it.
